DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 55 s. 2022 June 30, 2022 MS. EMILY M. BANAAG Carnival Fairs Owners' Society of the Philippines Inc. (C-FAIR) Brgy. San Juan, Calamba City, Laguna traditionalperJa16@gmaiI.com Dear Ms. Banaag: This has reference to your letter dated 26 May 2022 wherein you are seeking for clarification on whether your business, which is classified by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) as fairs and amusements is included in the suspension of Peryahan ng Bayan. To begin with, we would like to stress that what the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office ("PCSO") suspended the operation of Peryahan Games, pursuant to Memorandum dated January 29, 2020, issued by Executive Secretary Salvador Medialdea to PCSO, wherein it provides that the resumption of Peryahan Games operation is still suspended. In compliance therewith, this Department, in an Advisory dated 19 June 2020, disseminated information to all concerned officials and the public, regarding the advice of the PCSO to temporarily suspend the nationwide PCSO Lottery and other on line-gaming activities, such as, Digit Games, Keno, Small-Town Lotter, and Instant Sweepstakes (Scratch It), until further notice. Accordingly, we deem it necessary to explain that Peryahan ng Bayan is a number betting game regulated by the PCSO which is entirely different from carnivals and amusement parks, or fairs, which are traditionally referred to as "perya". In view thereof, carnival fairs, "peryahan" or "perya" are allowed to operate provided it is able to maintain a safe and healthy environment and encourage behaviors that reduce the spread of COVID-19 among staff and guests, as its operations will still be subjected to the local laws and rules. Hence, so long as the operators of the fairs or "peryahan" would be able to strictly comply with the existing local laws and rules of the local government units pertaining to its effort to contain the spread of the COVID-19, it can always seek assistance from such LGUs to allow them to perform and operate in its area. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: INGAN Underse tary for Local Government OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/rjki/clp copy furnished: DIRECTOR ARIEL O.
